top_news.title: Automatically detecting AI text in my browser
top_news.dek: A developer explores building a browser-based tool to automatically detect and flag AI-generated text in real-time.
top_news.brief: The author notes that while tools like Pangram exist, there is a need for background-scanning solutions that automatically identify AI content on websites. The goal is to move beyond manual verification toward a seamless, automated browsing experience that helps users filter or tag AI-generated text without active intervention.
top_news.image_alt: Browser extension interface for AI text detection

top_news.title: How well do agents use test/verification techniques?
top_news.dek: An analysis investigates whether instructing AI agents to use specific testing libraries actually improves code correctness.
top_news.brief: Despite the availability of effective testing techniques, software quality remains inconsistent. This study tests if simple, non-expert instructions to use standard testing libraries can improve agentic output, using a Zstd implementation benchmark to measure performance.
top_news.image_alt: Chart showing agentic coding performance metrics

top_news.title: Mistral AI: Making sovereign, open-weight AI the technology frontier
top_news.dek: Mistral AI has raised €3 billion in a Series D round, reaching a valuation of over €21 billion.
top_news.brief: Led by Samsung Electronics, this funding round marks the largest equity raise for a European tech company. The capital will be used to scale compute capacity for training frontier models and accelerate international commercial expansion.
top_news.image_alt: Mistral AI corporate logo and funding announcement graphic

top_news.title: Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page
top_news.dek: Reducto has launched r-1, a single-pass document parsing model that reduces errors by 20% at a lower cost.
top_news.brief: The r-1 model integrates OCR, layout detection, and table formatting into a single pass, replacing multi-stage agentic pipelines. It offers a significant cost reduction, pricing at 1 cent per page compared to the previous 3 to 6 cent range.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing single-pass document parsing architecture

top_news.title: llm 0.35
top_news.dek: The LLM CLI tool has been updated to version 0.35, adding support for OpenAI's gpt-6-astra model.
top_news.brief: Simon Willison’s command-line utility for interacting with local and remote language models now includes support for the latest GPT-6 Astra release, allowing users to access the model directly from their terminal.
top_news.image_alt: Terminal window showing LLM CLI command output

primary.title: OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device
primary.summary: OpenBMB has released MiniCPM5-2B, a dense causal language model with 2,516,756,480 parameters and a native 131,072 token context. It averages 53.9 across the 34 benchmarks in its model card, ahead of Qwen3.5-4B at 51.1, with its clearest leads in tool use, coding agents and long-context retrieval. Post-training pairs 400B tokens of deep-thinking SFT with RL teachers and on-policy distillation that merges 16 expert models into one checkpoint. The weights ship under Apache 2.0 alongside the pre-training, SFT and RL datasets and the intermediate Base, Midtrain and SFT-only checkpoints. GGUF build

primary.title: Axis Robotics Releases AXIS: A Browser-Based Data Engine With 207 Robot Manipulation Tasks and 50,129 Trajectories
primary.summary: Robot datasets have grown far slower than the models trained on them, mostly because collection stays locked to lab hardware. AXIS moves demonstration collection into a web browser and pushes everything expensive to backend GPUs. The result is 207 tasks and 50,129 verified Franka trajectories, and continual pretraining that lifts π0.5 from 83.9 to 88.8 on LIBERO-Plus while a volume-matched RoboCasa365 control reaches only 57.5. The post Axis Robotics Releases AXIS: A Browser-Based Data Engine With 207 Robot Manipulation Tasks and 50,129 Trajectories appeared first on MarkTechPost.
